title: Kraftwerk
scene: Düsseldorf early Krautrock and experimental art rock
notes: Treated flute and violin collide with organ drones, acoustic drums and musique concrète.

title: Kraftwerk 2
scene: Düsseldorf experimental rock / pre-synth Kraftwerk with modified rhythm box
notes: Tape-processed home-built rhythms and flutes drift through long instrumental experiments.

title: Ralf und Florian
scene: Düsseldorf Kling Klang; melodic transitional Krautrock/electronics
notes: Flute, Minimoog, rhythm boxes and wordless processed voices frame increasingly melodic experiments.

title: Autobahn
scene: Düsseldorf electronic pop and conceptual road music; Kling Klang
notes: Motorway sound effects, melodic synthesis and pastoral passages shape a landmark electronic travelogue.
